action: Speak straight to the fixed camera in a bright living room, with the excited, just-discovered tone of someone trying an outfit on at home and showing it to a friend — confident and playful, never salesy. Open standing very close to the lens with the outfit from @image2 on the person from @image1, then step back while saying 'why does this look this good'; land the stress on 'good' exactly as the full-length front view opens up. On 'when I walk' actually walk toward the lens, letting the wide trouser legs swing and part with each step. On 'The back' raise one hand near the shoulder, turn the shoulder away and rotate to a three-quarter back view so the back of the outfit from @image2 is the evidence; on 'yeah' glance back over the shoulder with a small smile and settle the pose. On 'the slit' slide one hand down the outside of the trouser leg to the hem opening. On 'Somebody knew exactly what they were doing' rotate back to the front, sweep a hand past the ear, and put a knowing half-smile on 'exactly'; then step backward so the whole front of the outfit fills the frame. On 'This is giving' begin turning to profile, hold the side silhouette through 'rich girl at midnight' with a look back to the lens, then on 'energy' swing front and walk toward the camera. On 'and I'm obsessed.' keep walking in until the framing tightens to a mid-shot, hold eye contact, and give one small satisfied nod on 'obsessed.'
